statements.text: File No. USD01-14/6/2026-ESTT.I proposes the continuation of 14 outsourced Data Entry Operators for 2026-27, suggesting that reference to the Finance Department may not be necessary.
statements.quote: Since the continuation is on the same terms, reference to the Finance Department may not be necessary.

statements.text: Under the expired G.O.Rt.No.1184, any continuation of contract and outsourcing services beyond 31-03-2026 requires fresh orders of the Government.
statements.quote: Any continuation beyond 31-03-2026 shall require fresh orders of the Government.
